title: 第21章 蜕变第22章 你家的武馆
content_zh:
“这不会还有淬体的效果吧？”
看着皮肤表面渗出一层黄中带黑的污垢，方南山惊讶无比。
可能是身体太弱了，承受不住这些生机能量的冲击，所以身体会出现损伤，但它们本身又有强大的治疗功能，损伤的区域马上就会被治疗恢复，有一种打破了重建的过程，在这个过程中，身体中的一些杂质自然被舍弃，排出体外。
他感觉全身被温暖的气流不断的冲刷，如有阵阵电流通过，有麻痒疼痛之感，但很快又会被舒坦代替，十分酸爽。
持续大约三分钟，这杯茶的生机气流才消耗殆尽。
冲进卫生间一番冲澡清理，方南山一身清爽的出来，只觉得全身充满了活力，仿佛一只老虎站在面前，他都能一拳打死。
“跟当初在仙界里学习了功法之后一样，这就是变强的感觉吗？不是说现实里实力提升都是缓慢增加吗？”
方南山有点疑惑，他之前的身体变化，并不是突然间蜕变的，而是睡一觉醒来，才发现身体步入新的层次。
现在却是在极短时间内身体出现巨大的变化，这种变化可以用脱胎换骨来形容。
这就是天材地宝的威能。
迫不及待的拿起手机，扫描一下现在的身体状态。
“咝！”
他看着上面数据的巨大变化，震惊得几乎不能言语。
【姓名】方南山
【籍贯】玄黄宇宙蓝星华国
【年龄】16120
【身体状态】力量：21，体质：25，敏捷：22，精神力：35
【个体潜质】根骨：5，悟性：7，意志：8
【天赋灵根】木：5，水：3，灵魂（异化）：7
【仙灵世界关联帐号】爱吃包子（0阶5级）

所有的属性都提升了，这是弱质凡体一瞬间进化到强壮武徒的层次。
最可怕的是根骨和灵根这种很难靠锻炼来提升的天赋潜质，现在都得到了巨大的提升，这可以让他以后的修行变得更加简单，修行之路走得更远。
“我终于可以开始修行了！”
“不过，好饿！感觉可以吃下三头牛。”
身体放松下来之后，方南山被身体里巨大的饥饿感吓一大跳，好像一万年没吃过饭一样，饿得想把整个屋子都啃掉。
家里翻了一遍，只有一点饼干，根本顶不了事。
“小区隔壁街好像有一家自助餐馆……”
方南山毫不犹豫的出门，飞奔冲向目标地点。
content_en:
"Wouldn't this also have a body-tempering effect?"
Fang Nanshan was extremely surprised when he saw a layer of yellow and black dirt seeping out from the surface of his skin.
It may be that the body is too weak to withstand the impact of these vital energies, so the body will be damaged, but they themselves have powerful healing functions. The damaged area will be treated and restored immediately. There is a process of breaking down and rebuilding. In this process, some impurities in the body are naturally discarded and excreted from the body.
He felt that his whole body was being washed away by warm air. If there were bursts of electricity passing through, he would feel numb and painful, but it would soon be replaced by comfort, which was very sour.
It lasted about three minutes before the vitality of the cup of tea was exhausted.
After rushing into the bathroom to take a shower and clean up, Fang Nanshan came out refreshed and felt that his whole body was full of energy, as if he could kill a tiger standing in front of him with one punch.
"It's the same as after learning the skills in the fairy world. Is this what it feels like to become stronger? Doesn't it mean that in reality, strength increases slowly?"
Fang Nanshan was a little confused. His previous physical changes were not a sudden transformation, but a sudden change after he woke up and found that his body had entered a new level.
Now, the body has undergone huge changes in a very short period of time. This change can be described as a rebirth.
This is the power of heavenly materials and earthly treasures.
I couldn't wait to pick up my phone and scan my current physical condition.
"His!"
He looked at the huge changes in the data above and was so shocked that he could hardly speak.
【Name】Fang Nanshan
【Birthplace】Xuanhuang Universe Blue Star China
【Age】16120
[Physical condition] Strength: 21, Constitution: 25, Agility: 22, Mental strength: 35
[Individual potential] Root: 5, Comprehension: 7, Will: 8
[Talent Spirit Root] Wood: 5, Water: 3, Soul (alienation): 7
[Fairy World Linked Account] Loves to eat steamed buns (level 0 and level 5)
All attributes have been improved. This is the level where a weak mortal body has evolved into a strong warrior in an instant.
The most frightening thing is that the talent potential of root bones and spiritual roots, which are difficult to improve through exercise, has now been greatly improved, which can make his future practice easier and his path of practice go further.
"I can finally start practicing!"
"But I'm so hungry! I feel like I could eat three cows."
After his body relaxed, Fang Nanshan was startled by the huge hunger in his body, as if he hadn't eaten in ten thousand years. He was so hungry that he wanted to eat the whole house.
I searched the house and found only a few biscuits, which couldn't do anything.
"There seems to be a cafeteria on the street next to the community..."
Fang Nanshan went out without hesitation and rushed towards the target location.
